HEADER: Init +6; Senses Darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +10
DEFENSE: AC 17, touch 13, flat-footed 15 (+2 dex, +4 natural, +1 size)
Defensive Abilities Hardness 5, Living-like; Immune construct traits, blind, curse, petrification, silence; Resist fire 10, ice 10, wind 10, earth 10, lightning 10, water 10;
TACTICS: During Combat The Brina will generally stay in the back and heal her allies until her MP is out while using dance when she can.
OFFENSE: At will - Detect Magic, Holy Orb, Message, Read Magic
3rd (DC 16) - Cure III, Protect II, Shell II
STATISTICS: Str 10, Dex 15, Con -, Int 13, Wis 17, Cha 16
Feats Combat Casting, Extend Spell, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Once every 1d2+1 rounds as a standard action, Brina can perform Mystic Dances like the Dancer class can do however without taking attacks of opportunity and does not cost any MP or Ki to use. Brina is limited to up to lvl 7 Mystic Dance and cannot use any that have a prerequisites like Curing Waltz II.

1/day, Brina can increase the potency of her next healing spell as a swift action, so long as the casting time of the spell is 1 standard action or less. The next healing spell the Brina casts heals for half again as many hit points.

Calca gains the benefit of extra hit points from Charisma instead of size due to being a construct which means she can also be healed by normal means. She also gain feats and skills due to having an Intelligence. Her saves are also consider Good unlike most constructs.

curation.summary: Brina is packaged as an FFD20 NPC actor with 30 generated item(s) across 7 populated mechanics categories.
rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
